title: Production architecture: queues, cache and idempotent effects
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects production architecture: queues, cache and idempotent effects with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Architecture acceptance measures successful tasks under failure, not only normal throughput.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: A production AI path includes authentication, admission control, retrieval, provider work, validation and response delivery. Caches reduce repeated work, queues decouple long tasks, circuit breakers limit calls to failing dependencies and fallbacks preserve a smaller safe capability. Each mechanism changes failure behavior and needs a contract.
Idempotency means repeating a request has the same intended effect as executing it once. A timeout is ambiguous: the remote system may have completed work even if the client received no response.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Key caches by tenant, permission scope, normalized request, prompt/model versions and index generation. Bound TTL and invalidate after permission or document changes. For side effects, persist an idempotency record before execution and return its existing result on duplicate requests.

A circuit breaker moves closed to open after configured failures, then half-open for limited probes after cooldown. Queued work has an expiry and cancellation path. Fallback answers must indicate reduced capability and retain the same authorization rules.

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: An open breaker routes to a backup provider with a different schema and the application treats arbitrary text as valid. A global cache returns another tenant's answer. A retry storm fills the queue faster than workers can drain it.
Inject provider outage, slow storage, duplicate requests and permission revocation. Check bounded queue growth, consistent duplicate results, visible degraded mode and eventual recovery.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: Architecture acceptance measures successful tasks under failure, not only normal throughput. Document which dependency failures cause abstention, fallback or rejection.
SDETs should verify each transition with controlled faults and preserve traces for diagnosis. A retry mechanism is reliable only when it respects effect safety, capacity and deadlines.

quiz.explanation: The cached evidence and answer are authorized only within their original scope.

quiz.question: A candidate for production architecture: queues, cache and idempotent effects meets the happy path but fails the phase's documented counterexample. What is the defensible decision?
options: Hold release, preserve the failing case and fix the responsible boundary
Release because the happy path passed
Delete the failing case to improve the score
quiz.explanation: The failing counterexample disproves the claimed contract. Retain it as regression evidence and rerun the corrected boundary.
